CustomField.inlineHelpText: This category focuses on the style, clarity, and organization of responses. It includes guidelines on language usage, adherence to local conventions, and the structure of the response to ensure it is clear, direct, and easily understandable. These guidelines help in maintaining a professional and coherent communication style that enhances the effectiveness and accessibility of the information provided.
